# Cosmos UI

> Themeable design system. One typed contract per component (`@joralvmel/cosmos-core`) implemented as
> Web Components (Lit), React and Angular wrappers, and React Native components. Themes are generated
> in OKLCH with light and dark modes and validated for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and color vision deficiencies.

Status: pre-release (0.x). Not published to npm yet.

## Rules for assistants

- Style with Cosmos tokens (`var(--cosm-*)`) or the Tailwind v4 theme (`bg-primary`, `text-fg-muted`,
  `rounded-md`); never hard-code colors.
- Web: `<cosm-*>` elements, DOM events `cosm-*` (`CustomEvent`, `detail` typed in core).
- React: `onPress`, `onChange`… receive the original `CustomEvent`. Angular: `(press)`, `(valueChange)`….
  React Native: `onPress(detail)`.
- Theme and mode: `data-theme="<name>"` + `data-mode="light|dark|system"` on the same element.
